payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance metrics comparing the SubGram model to the Skip-gram model, indicating the gains achieved by SubGram.

claims.text: SubGram significantly outperforms the Skip-gram model on the same training set, achieving 22.4% compared to Skip-gram's 9.7%.
On the original test set, SubGram performs similarly to Skip-gram, with scores of 42.5% for SubGram and 42.3% for Skip-gram.
